experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: AI personalization in RBC's mobile banking app for 1.5M+ users (2B+ insights delivered). Features that surfaced spending insights, auto-saved spare cash, budgeting, a conversational assistant, and cash-flow forecasts. Impact: ~$415/mo saved per client → C$1.7B+ total, 1M+ assistant questions across 12 languages, and session time doubled (3.5 → 7.5 min). Core challenge: moving real-time personalization off the legacy mainframe onto a modern event-driven platform, with regulator-required explainability on every decision.
